title.from: Pilobol.us P3-03: infra template adopts the live apps (reader by id, optional domains) and a reviewed non-replacing change set for the CMS stack
title.to: Pilobol.us P3-02: template for NEW repo-less apps: optional domains/staging/reader domain, stackName, boto3 in reader specs (with PPY-a91e9c)

description.from:
## Goal
Make the Papyrus infra template able to ADOPT the live Pilobol.us apps instead of creating new ones, and produce a reviewed, non-replacing CloudFormation change set for the existing stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us.

## Context (FACT, verified 2026-10-06, read-only AWS)
- CMS app d11eu9hbs2mipk (pilobol-us-cms, WEB_COMPUTE) belongs to stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us (created 2026-09-08 by the OLD shell). Its logical ids are App, Branch, Domain, AmplifyServiceRole*, AmplifyComputeRole*: the same ids the new template uses (App, Branch, AmplifyServiceRole, AmplifyComputeRole), so adoption in place is plausible. Deployed App has Repository = AnthusAI/Papyrus plus an AccessToken (PAT via secret amplify/github-app-token); the new template sets neither.
- Deployed Branch main env (names): PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND, NEXT_PUBLIC_PAPYRUS_SITE_BRAND, PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE (value graphql, which is INVALID on develop: lib/site-env.ts accepts only published or drafts), PAPYRUS_EDITION_SLUG, PAPYRUS_ENABLE_* (4), PAPYRUS_COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX, PAPYRUS_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URLS. The template adds SITE_ENV=production and PAPYRUS_CONTENT_SOURCE=published. PAPYRUS_DISABLE_GOOGLE_OAUTH is in the stored template but NOT on the live branch (Google IdP exists in the user pool).
- The live app buildSpec is the legacy one (npm install, ampx pipeline-deploy --debug, env capture of 3 vars). The template generates npm ci + papyrus-app sync.
- Template gaps (infra/amplify-app-shell/lib): site.json frontend markus-static REQUIRES a reader block, which always creates a NEW reader app, a branch and the domain (pilobol.us is owned by live app d1od6t7lzbwanr: would collide); AmplifyAppShellStack always creates newsroom and staging domains + a staging branch (ticket PPY-a91e9c covers making them optional); the reader/staging specs install papyrus-newsroom[markus] (boto3 gap fixed in the guest-mode ticket).
- Reader app d1od6t7lzbwanr is hand-made: not in any stack, no service role, repo-level amplify.yml.

## Exact changes
1. site.json: add reader.amplifyAppId (existing app): when present the stack creates NO reader app/branch/domain/role; the id only feeds the backend config (StartJob IAM) and print-buildspec output. Validation + tests (synth with and without).
2. Combine with PPY-a91e9c (domains and staging optional): site.json flags so a first adoption deploy changes only: app buildSpec, branch env, no PAT, and creates no domain or staging branch (those arrive in the staging ticket).
3. A helper, papyrus-infra changeset --site site.json --stack <name>: synth, then aws cloudformation create-change-set (UPDATE, not executed) and prints Action/Replacement per resource. Read-only except the change-set object; deleting the change set at the end.
4. Run it against amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us with infra/amplify-app-shell/examples/pilobol-us.site.json adapted (repository AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, brand pilobol-us, papyrusVersion = the pin chosen in the scaffold ticket, reader.amplifyAppId d1od6t7lzbwanr). Record the table here.

## Acceptance checks
- Unit tests: npx tsx scripts/test-infra-site-config.ts and node scripts/test-infra-synth.mjs cover adopt mode (no reader app resources, no domains).
- Change set shows NO Replacement for App, Branch, Domain, both roles. If App Repository/AccessToken removal is anything but an in-place Modify, STOP and report: fallback is in the plan (section 4.2, replacement app on an empty backend).
- The change set is created and deleted without being executed; stack LastUpdatedTime unchanged afterwards.

## Rollback
Delete the change set (aws cloudformation delete-change-set). Nothing else is touched.

## Risks
- Removing Repository/AccessToken from an Amplify App via CloudFormation is UNVERIFIED (ASSUMPTION): Amplify may reject it or detach the repo. Only the change set (and later the console connect) can show it.
- The role AdministratorAccess policy is by design (documented risk in the shell README).

## Needs Ryan
OK to create (not execute) the change set against the live stack (a write of one change-set object). SSO login.

## Common rules (apply to every Phase 3 Pilobol.us ticket)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (AnthusAI/Papyrus, PR from branch docs/PPY-3367d3-pilobol-us-migration-plan). Facts there were verified 2026-10-06; marked FACT or ASSUMPTION. Re-verify anything you depend on before acting.
- LIVE steps (marked LIVE) touch production resources (apps d1od6t7lzbwanr and d11eu9hbs2mipk, their branches, domains, stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us, the CMS backend). Do them ONLY after Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step. Everything else is read-only AWS (list/get/describe) or scratch work.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, region us-east-1 (SSO login is Ryan's). Never print an env var or secret VALUE (names only; the apps hold secrets in env vars and SSM). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally (Amplify builds do that).
- The local checkout /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us is read-only for us, and its build REWRITES content front matter and generated files: never build there. Build only in scratch copies of a fresh clone (git clone https://github.com/AnthusAI/Pilobol.us, or git archive origin/main).
- Papyrus repo work: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, branch feature/PPY-<id>-<slug> (or chore/ for docs), PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, conventional commits, commit trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo work: a feature branch and a PR; never push or merge to its main (production reader deploys from main). In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus run only kbs; never git add or commit there. Tickets live on the PPY board; do not use kbs in the Pilobol.us repo (PILO board is stories only).
- Keep article text byte-identical everywhere. Narration (Auritus) hashes cover article text: any text change re-queues Batch jobs.
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link, command output and numbers when done.
description.to:
## Goal
Make the Papyrus infra template able to stand up Pilobol.us as NEW repo-less apps without touching the old ones: optional domains and staging branch (merge with PPY-a91e9c), reader domain optional, and the reader/staging specs get boto3.

## Context (FACT, 2026-10-06)
- Decision (Ryan): create new apps from the template, connect repos with the Amplify GitHub App in the console, move domains afterwards, delete the old apps and the old empty backend. The old CMS app d11eu9hbs2mipk lives in stack amplify-app-shell-pilobol-us (same stack name the template would use for siteId pilobol-us) and owns newsroom.pilobol.us; old reader d1od6t7lzbwanr owns pilobol.us and www. A domain can belong to one app only, so the new stack must start with NO domains and add them at the end.
- The template (infra/amplify-app-shell/lib) today always creates newsroom and staging domains plus a staging branch, requires cms.domainName, hostedZoneId and repository, and for markus-static always creates a reader app with domain.
- Generated reader and staging specs install papyrus-newsroom[markus]; S3 media needs boto3 (extra newsroom): export-published would fail (src/papyrus_content/media_store.py).
- Connect test (2026-10-06, PPY-a91e9c): console connect to a repo-less app works; it may flip platform to WEB and replace the service role: verify and fix with aws amplify update-app --platform WEB_COMPUTE.

## Exact steps
1. Do PPY-a91e9c: cms.domainName and cms.stagingDomainName optional; omit the Domain resources when absent; staging branch optional (flag); reader.domainName optional; hostedZoneId and OAuth redirect URL validation adjusted (redirects may use the default amplifyapp.com origins). Synth tests with and without domains.
2. Stack name: add optional site.json stackName (default amplify-app-shell-<siteId>) so the new stack can coexist with the old one until it is deleted (siteId stays pilobol-us; app names pilobol-us-cms and pilobol-us-reader).
3. Reader and staging specs: install papyrus-newsroom[markus] plus boto3 (or rely on boto3 added to the markus extra by the guest-read ticket: coordinate, do it once).
4. Update docs/site-hosting.md runbook and infra README.

## Acceptance checks
- npx tsx scripts/test-infra-site-config.ts and node scripts/test-infra-synth.mjs pass with a domain-free site.json (no AWS::Amplify::Domain in the template).
- Spec snapshot shows boto3 available.

## Rollback
Revert the PR (develop only).

## Risks
Domain-free first deploy then domain add-on: the second stack update is where the domain moves (cert validation wait).

## Needs Ryan
Nothing.

## Common rules (Phase 3 Pilobol.us, simplified plan v2)
- Plan: docs/migrations/pilobol-us.md (PR AnthusAI/Papyrus#128). Ryan 2026-10-06: Pilobol.us is PRE-PRODUCTION, Git history is the rollback, HARD CUTOVER: no soak, no Git freeze, no dual Git/CMS build path, no parity gate, brief downtime is fine. New Amplify apps are created from the template; the old apps and the old EMPTY backend are retired at the end.
- Read AGENTS.local.md first. AWS_PROFILE=legacy, us-east-1 (SSO is Ryan's). Never print env var or secret VALUES (names only). Never run ampx pipeline-deploy locally. Creating, changing or deleting AWS resources needs Ryan's explicit yes in chat for that step; deleting data or stacks is done by Ryan (or on his explicit yes).
- Never build in /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us (its build rewrites content): use a fresh clone or a worktree.
- Papyrus repo: worktree of origin/develop under /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus-worktrees/, feature/PPY-<id>-<slug>, PR into develop, never merge to main, never git stash, trailer Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>, PR body ends with the Claude Code generated-with line. Pilobol.us repo: feature branch + PR, never push to its main. In /Users/home/Projects/Papyrus only run kbs.
- Keep article text verbatim (the importer already does; narration hashes depend on it). The Auritus embed is origin-locked to the site key's origin; the production origin stays pilobol.us, so nothing changes there (narration will not play on temporary amplifyapp.com URLs: expected).
- Update this ticket with branch, PR link and command output when done.
